system.description: For one Blood Trait, everyone sharing your location comes to admire, respect, and love you as a significant authority figure for the rest of the scene unless you turn the power off; none will attempt to harm you and most can be coaxed into reasonable requests, though not outright self-harm. If you visibly betray their trust, the effect cannot be reestablished on them for the rest of the session short of using Forgetful Mind, and subjects may grow anxious or clingy when separated from you even after the scene ends.
